integrity: All thresholds are derived from the printed vector fields and checked by independent scalar bracketing and Routh-Hurwitz sign analysis; no numerical trajectory evidence is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium count and linear stability only for the printed asymmetric Cases C and D over their plotted parameter windows; nonlinear Hopf criticality, basin geometry, and global attractor classification are not claimed.
title: Exact equilibrium skeleton of the symmetry-broken hyperbolic-sine jerk cases
